title: A free beginning and a changing response

captions.physics: Tying an attempt to compulsory continuation
captions.energy: Opening conversation without a ready script

meaning: You can freely try another conversation and acknowledge a changing response while noticing a successful attempt tied to compulsory continuation.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Devil in the physical position can appear in linking an attempt with required continuation. The Fool in energy encourages conversation without a ready script and room for an unknown answer. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings a changing response. You can enjoy an unexpected subject and later feel tired or cautious. Initial pleasure need not become an agreement to continue identically, while a changed feeling does not cancel genuine interest.

For example, you first share amusing everyday details through voice messages. A successful remark prompts “Now we must do this every evening”. You can notice the condition and leave the attempt open. **A pleasant beginning promises no unchanging wish**. You discuss what genuinely appeals to continue and what now feels excessive. A response can change without accusation of inconsistency. Yet freedom does not erase specific promises already voiced; it concerns a future way of talking not yet agreed.

Pressure returns if caution is taken as rejecting all closeness already experienced. Spontaneity is then permitted only with constant encouragement, strengthening the condition. The Fool’s constructive openness helps leave the next move unknown. You can value a successful attempt and hear another present wish; free conversation permits change, while a new feeling need neither justify an earlier one nor turn every pleasant remark into an indefinite obligation.
